claims.text: The FDA dalteparin label lists concomitant use of NSAIDs among factors that can increase the risk of epidural or spinal hematomas in anticoagulated patients.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of other drugs that affect hemostasis, such as non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), platelet inhibitors, other anticoagulants.

headline.text: The FDA dalteparin boxed warning lists concomitant NSAID use as a factor that can increase spinal or epidural hematoma risk (c1).

reported.text: The FDA dalteparin label lists NSAIDs, platelet inhibitors and other anticoagulants among drugs affecting hemostasis that can increase the risk of epidural or spinal hematomas.

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
